<!--
GitHub Issues are for bugs in the Signal iOS client only. They are not for questions, comments, or feature requests.

- Feature requests and discussion: https://community.signalusers.org
- Support: https://support.signal.org or support@signal.org

High-quality issues help us understand and fix bugs more quickly. Issues lacking detail are difficult for us to resolve, and may be closed.
-->

## Reporter checklist

Administrative:

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/signalapp/Signal-iOS/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have searched open and closed issues for duplicates.
- [ ] This is a bug in existing functionality, not a feature request or discussion topic.

Details:

- [ ] I have verified that the issue reproduces on the latest version of Signal.
- [ ] I have included a detailed description and steps to reproduce.
- [ ] I have included screenshots or a screen recording documenting the issue.
- [ ] I have included debug logs from all devices involved.
- [ ] If the issue is a crash, I have included crash reports (`.ips` files).
